SELECT o.status, o.login_state, COUNT(*) AS rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS orders,
       MIN(o.order_ts_utc) mn, MAX(o.order_ts_utc) mx
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT o.web_order_id, o.status, o.order_ts_utc, o.line_count, o.order_total_gross, s.store_id, p.category, p.product_name
FROM fact_web_order o
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
  AND (p.category = 'ZZ Test' OR s.store_id = 999)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS n_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_dispatch,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_ids_all
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
